verdict_reason: Nearest-crossing match of pyMack's neutral locus to the digitized arch: median |Δα|/α = 15.8% over 20 in-range points (50% within the 15% band). Best-tracked sub-range: Re 800-1400 (4 pts, median 10.5%) — this is the arch apex / cutoff region. Onset (lower) branch labelled match: median 40% over 6 pts. Cutoff (upper) branch labelled match: median 64% over 14 pts. Topology: pyMack's unstable region is an OPEN lobe, not the paper's CLOSED arch — at high Re the nearest crossing does not follow the digitized branch back down, and (at M>=4) extra near-floor crossings from the marginally-damped first mode and a near-ceiling spurious continuous-spectrum crossing appear. This is the repo's documented first-mode / continuous-spectrum formulation discrepancy, not digitization noise, so the verdict is 'disagrees', not 'agrees'.
pymack_provenance: c_i grid verification/neutralCurve_verification/_ozgen_compute/ozgen_combined_ci_grid.csv (24x30 mesh, log-spaced Re x linear alpha), from scripts/make_ozgen_fig3_overlay.py (solve_temporal_ozgen_2d, L* scale, classified TS/Mack modes); per-Mach slice copied to verification/neutralCurve_verification/ozgen_m2/pymack_ozgen_M2_ci_grid.csv. Neutral alpha located by bilinear (log-Re) zero-crossing of c_i along alpha at each digitized Re, matched to the NEAREST crossing (headline metric); lower/upper branch-labelled crossings reported as diagnostics.
